title: A 10 years old developer who has become a DEV.to Trusted Member! 😱

content_html:
I still can't believe it! I just noticed the Trusted Member badge on my DEV.to profile, and I'm genuinely SO excited!

My Story: From a Black Star to the Pole Star ⭐

I joined DEV Community (dev.to) on October 19. Honestly, I didn't join just to create another account or publish articles. I joined because I wanted to learn, explore new things, share my thoughts, and do something meaningful with my skills.

Where I live, not many people take my abilities seriously. Some of my classmates even call me a Black Star and say that I can never shine. Sometimes, their words make me question myself. They make me feel as if I don't know enough or that I won't be able to achieve anything.

But thankfully, my family has always been there for me. My brother, especially, supports me a lot. The only thing is that nobody in my family comes from a Tech background. They are all connected to Finance, so I didn't really have anyone around me who could guide me in the world of technology.

Still, I wanted to learn.

I've been interested in JavaScript since I was 6 years old, but having an interest in something and actually knowing how to build things are two different experiences. I had plenty of ideas in my mind, but I didn't have enough knowledge or experience to turn them into real projects.

Then came October 19.

I joined DEV Community, started exploring articles, reading other developers' experiences, and learning things I had never tried before. Slowly, I started understanding more about development. I also began working on my own ideas instead of just thinking about them.

And guess what?

I finally built my first project after joining DEV.to!

It might not be a huge achievement for everyone, but for me, it means a lot. Because I know how much it took to go from having an idea in my mind to actually building something with my own hands.

Some day I think about what my classmates used to say. They called me a Black Star, someone who could never shine.

But maybe I was never a Black Star. Maybe I was just trying to shine in the wrong sky.

Today, I like to think of myself as a Pole Star. ⭐

Not because I've achieved something extraordinary, but because I want to keep growing, keep learning, and someday become someone who can help others find their direction too.

This is just the beginning of my journey. I have many ideas, many projects to build, and countless things to learn.

I don't know how far this journey will take me, but I'm excited to find out.

I am not here to prove everyone wrong. I'm here to learn, create, improve, and become a better version of myself.

And this time, I'm not going to let anyone decide how brightly I can shine. ❤️

A special thank you to Necoz. Being part of this organization has helped me learn, explore, connect with people, and grow as a little developer.

I know I still have so much to learn. I'm exploring JavaScript, getting interested in Python, building little projects, and sharing my learning journey with the community.

My JavaScript badge

This badge means more to me than I can explain. It's a little motivation to keep learning, creating, and contributing.

Thank you, NecoZ, and thank you, DEV.to!

I'M SO EXCITED FOR WHAT'S NEXT! 🚀
